description_en: Maintain the recording information after real-time quality inspection is completed, which is used to play back the recording during review. After the recording information is maintained, the task status will change to Succeeded.
description_zh: 来维护实时质检完成后的录音信息，用来复核时播放录音，并且维护录音信息后，任务状态将变为已完成
name: UpdateSyncQualityCheckData
